google/abfs-casfs.readme_excerpt: CASFS - Content-Addressable Storage File-System === CASFS is a Linux file system in which files and directories are identified by the hash of their content, using the Git object model (SHA-1). Everything is loaded lazily: a directory or file is materialized from its hash only when it is accessed, and missing objects are fetched on demand from a user-space cache daemon over a Unix domain socket.
